title: Verification ancestry checks
responsibility: Checks that inherited base and scenario evidence comes from available, matching, passing and sound records without cycles.

inputs.name: recordLineage.record
inputs.description: Verification record whose base and referenced scenario ancestry should be checked.

inputs.name: recordLineage.source
inputs.description: Lookup for stored records and callback reporting record identity, seal and evidence problems.

inputs.name: recordLineage.path
inputs.description: Optional ancestor id trail, default empty, used to detect cyclic inheritance.

outputs.name: recordLineage
outputs.description: Problem strings for missing, mismatched, failed, damaged or cyclic ancestry and changed inherited states. An empty list means no examined lineage violation; checks are cached per object only within this call.
